scope: Additive primary-source recheck of Earthquake Boots radius units and the L9-18 post-2025 building-damage table. No combat effect is enabled.
game_version: Supercell September 2024 balance announcement and February 2025 balance announcement; February 2026 ground-troop change remains in scope. Current executable and later unlisted balance changes are unverified.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: The September balance note explicitly increases the effect radius from six to eight tiles at all levels.
Its L9-18 post-change damage table is a historical predecessor to the later February 2025 nerf.
sources.limitations: The note gives tile units, not the center, target hitbox, footprint intersection, edge inclusion, activation sample time or tick order.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The prose says building damage is reduced and the level table gives post-change damage of 34%, 36%, 38% and 40% for L9-18 bands.
The active ability no longer affects Skeleton Trap skeletons in this announced update.
sources.limitations: The table does not cover L1-8, Wall damage, damage against ground troops, damage arithmetic or the status of the Skeleton Trap exception after February 2026.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
facts: The Earthquake Spell's new ground-troop damage behavior explicitly affects Earthquake Boots.
sources.limitations: The note supplies no ground-troop percentage, target exceptions, Wall formula or tick order.

derivations.result: The frozen abilityRadius 8 has a directly sourced tile unit, while its geometry convention remains open.
derivations.method: Compare the all-level official September 2024 radius statement to the pinned normalized top-level abilityRadius field.

derivations.result: All ten frozen L9-18 buildingDamagePercent values match the official announced February 2025 post-nerf table.
derivations.method: Use the official prose to identify the damage category and compare each post-change table value to the normalized per-level source_fields.stats.buildingDamagePercent. Do not transfer the values to other target classes.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the eight-tile radius using center-to-center distance
rejected_inferences.reason: Only the unit and magnitude are published; entity geometry and boundary convention are not.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the L9-18 building percentages for Walls or ground troops
rejected_inferences.reason: The table describes the building nerf and does not publish Wall or troop damage formulas.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat frozen L1-8 area percentages as current
rejected_inferences.reason: The official 2025 table starts at L9 and the later ground-troop change does not fill those rows.

rejected_inferences.rule: Assume the 2025 Skeleton Trap exclusion was removed in 2026
rejected_inferences.reason: The February 2026 note names ground troops generally but does not revisit the specific exception.

rejected_inferences.rule: Enable active area damage in Core
rejected_inferences.reason: Activation, target enumeration, geometry, Wall formula, ground-troop damage and same-tick order remain unspecified.

items: current L1-8 building damage and all-level Wall and ground-troop damage
radius center, hitbox, footprint and edge inclusion despite the confirmed eight-tile unit
post-2026 Skeleton Trap skeleton exception and ground Hero, Pet and spawned-unit eligibility
Wall destruction formula, target enumeration, activation and damage/death tick order
Hero HP and DPS bonus application and two-Equipment stacking
Viewer art and overlays, activation controls, snapshot, replay and RL command contract

conclusion: The radius is officially eight tiles at all levels and the retained L9-18 building percentages match the official February 2025 nerf table. Earthquake Boots remains partial and catalogue-only; later ground-target behavior and deterministic activation are not established.
